from Crypto.Hash import SHA
from Cryptodome.Cipher import ARC4 as pycryptodomex_arc4

    sealed = legacy.encrypt(message)
    modern = pycryptodomex_arc4.new(tempkey)
    return sealed, modern.encrypt(message)
